label: Mediant 1000B modular voice gateway / eSBC
description: Modular 19-inch voice gateway and eSBC whose six telephony slots take 4-port FXS, FXO or BRI modules (up to 24 FXS, 24 FXO or 20 BRI ports) alongside three 10/100/1000BASE-T LAN ports on the CRMX module, expandable to seven with SWX LAN expansion modules.
notes: AudioCodes hardware installation manual (LTRT-41441): up to six FXS modules of four RJ-11 ports each (24 FXS), up to six FXO modules of four ports (24 FXO), up to five BRI modules of four BRI ports each; the telephony mix depends on the ordered configuration. Up to seven LAN Ethernet interfaces - three on the CRMX module plus the SWX LAN expansion modules - which can be paired into Ethernet Groups for 1+1 port redundancy. Only the three on-board CRMX gigabit ports are modelled as fixed. E1/T1 PRI trunks are optional modules and are not modelled as Ethernet.
